title: How Olney Ramblers Load Pollen Into Finished-Basement Ducts
headline: Georgia Avenue ramblers, Norbeck split-levels, and why rec rooms hide sweating trunks
description: Olney, MD ramblers sit farther up Montgomery County under a thick canopy. Learn why finished basements store pollen in cool trunks, and when to clean them from Bethesda.

sections.heading: Olney is farther than Wheaton. The canopy is thicker.
paragraphs: Georgia Avenue through the village, Olney Mill, Norbeck, then lanes toward Brookeville: 1960s–80s ramblers and split-levels. Families finished the basements. The air handler stayed down there. That is a clean-looking rec room over a trunk that still sweats.

Once you leave the Beltway the county canopy is thick. Oak and pine dump pollen onto every deck. Returns pull it into those basement trunks. Finished rooms hide the dust until the AC starts after a wet week and the smell walks upstairs.

sections.heading: A finished basement is not a finished HVAC system
paragraphs: Drop ceilings and carpet hide original metal. Joints that leaked in 1978 still leak. A rambler that added a rec room rarely resized the returns. Dust settles where you cannot see it. Dryer runs from a first-floor laundry often drop into that same damp space.
If the rec room smells musty when the AC starts, start with [air duct cleaning in Olney, MD](/locations/olney).

sections.heading: Typical signs in an Olney rambler
listItems: Musty air walking upstairs from a finished basement after rain.
Pollen film on supplies even with a new filter.
A dryer that takes too long on a drop into the lower level.

sections.heading: Up Georgia Avenue from Bethesda — not an Olney Mill suite
paragraphs: Olney is served from our [Bethesda](/locations/bethesda) office. Nearby [Rockville](/locations/rockville) uses the same Maryland crew. The drive is farther than Wheaton and we will say so. There is no Olney storefront.
Book on the [Olney location page](/locations/olney). Add [dryer vent cleaning](/dryer-vent-cleaning) if the laundry dumps into the basement.
listItems: Dehumidify finished basements in summer, not only the upstairs.
Change filters when oak and pine are dumping pollen.
Clean ducts every 3 to 5 years; clear dryer vents about once a year.

faq.q: Why do Olney finished basements make the vents smell?
faq.a: The air handler stayed in the coolest room. Trunks sweat. Pollen from the outer-county canopy sticks. The blower then pushes that odor upstairs.
